tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a retirement income plan for Elias Copperwisp and Lena Copperwisp that identifies expected spending needs, reliable income sources, portfolio withdrawal strategy, tax considerations, reserve targets, and implementation actions. Use current client data and clearly note assumptions, risks, and follow-up items. Model the cash flow after Elias's expected mid-2027 departure from Clockwork Clover Design and Lena's 2030 freelance wind-down, using household spending of about $11,800 per month, Social Security estimates of $3,050 and $2,100 per month, transferred assets, tax projections, and reserve targets.

subTasks.title: Gather income and spending inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates, Social Security assumptions, pension details, required distributions, cash reserves, and known one-time expenses. Note any missing items for client follow-up.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax-aware sequencing
subTasks.text: Compare sustainable withdrawal options, account sequencing, Roth conversion considerations, and taxable income impacts. Document planning assumptions and sensitivity points.

subTasks.title: Align portfolio and cash reserve strategy
subTasks.text: Review allocation, liquidity needs, near-term distribution sources, and risk exposure. Identify trades, cash raises, or rebalancing actions needed to support the income plan.

subTasks.title: Prepare client summary and implementation list
subTasks.text: Draft a plain-language summary with recommended distribution approach, monitoring cadence, open questions, and action items for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that model by December 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Coordinate the charitable transfer request for Elias Copperwisp, ensuring the receiving charity information, asset source, tax documentation needs, and completion confirmation are handled through appropriate handoffs. Elias asked about donating appreciated Moonbadger Automation shares from the taxable account to Whistling Pebble Literacy Fund, which wants assets received during the current tax year.

subTasks.title: Confirm charitable transfer intent and recipient details
subTasks.text: Confirm the gift purpose, asset or cash source, approximate amount or shares, receiving charity legal name, delivery instructions, and whether the client needs recognition preferences documented.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions for review
subTasks.text: Draft the transfer instructions, identify custodian or charity form requirements, and verify whether cost basis, lot selection, qualified charitable distribution treatment, or donor-advised fund routing applies.

subTasks.title: Submit and monitor transfer status
subTasks.text: After approval and signatures are complete, submit through the approved channel and track custodian or charity confirmation until assets or funds are received.

subTasks.title: Document confirmation and tax records
subTasks.text: Save confirmation, receipt, acknowledgement letter, and any relevant tax-reporting notes to the client file. Flag missing receipts or discrepancies for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the potential gift by December 10, 2025.
